question: Who received the National Nritya Shiromani award 2019 for promoting Kathak dance form across the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anindita Neogy Anaam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Anindita Neogy Anaam is a renowned Kathak dancer known for her remarkable contributions to the dance form.
 
• She received the National Nritya Shiromani award in 2019 for promoting Kathak across the globe.
 
• The award was presented at the 10th Cuttack Mahotsav: International Dance and Music Festival held in Odisha.
 
• Anindita is celebrated for her innovative approach in blending traditional Kathak with contemporary elements, making it more appealing to the younger generation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak Dance Form:**

 
 
• Kathak is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, originating from Northern India.
 
• It is characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures.
 
• The dance form traditionally narrates stories from Indian epics, folklore, and mythology.
 
• Kathak has three main gharanas (schools) - Lucknow, Jaipur, and Banaras, each with its unique style and emphasis.
 
 
 
• **National Nritya Shiromani Award:**
 
 
• This award is given to exceptional dancers who have significantly contributed to the promotion and preservation of Indian classical dance forms.
 
• It recognizes artists who have achieved excellence in their field and have promoted the art form both nationally and internationally.
 
 
 
• **Cuttack Mahotsav:**
 
 
• An international festival that celebrates dance and music, held annually in Cuttack, Odisha.
 
• The festival aims to promote cultural exchange and provides a platform for artists from various parts of the world to showcase their talents.
 
 
 
• **Role of Dance Festivals:**
 
 
• Dance festivals play a crucial role in preserving and promoting cultural heritage.
 
• They provide a platform for emerging artists to perform and gain recognition.
 
• Such festivals encourage the younger generation to appreciate and learn classical dance forms.
